lines.text: A woman comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved.
Love is as strong as death, and mighty waters cannot quench it.
If the little sister is a door, they will enclose her with panels of oak.
Solomon had a vineyard in Baal-hamon, and each tenant was to bring a thousand shekels of gold.
The beloved is invited to come away like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.
